provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: by hand: four product stabilizer states spanning Sym^3(C^2), coefficients fitted exactly in Q(zeta_16)

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; direct construction, no search

notes: |0>^3, |1>^3, |+>^3 and |->^3 span the four-dimensional symmetric subspace (|+>^3 and |->^3 separate the Dicke states of even and odd weight), so chi <= 4 at three copies for every single-qubit state. With the exact Galois lower bound 4 the cell is settled, chi(|sqrtT>^3) = 4, against 3 for the T state. Coefficients are short polynomials in zeta_16 = e^{i pi/8} times powers of sqrt 2, solved by fit_coeffs inside Q(zeta_16) (the generic sympy route mis-simplifies them), and the identity is checked symbolically. Implied gamma 2/3 against the published 1/2. The numerical rank-3 exclusion over the 1,080 three-qubit states (research survey, 2026-10-17) came within 0.0019 of the parallel threshold, under rank_exclusion's margin of 0.01, which is why the exact Galois certificate stands behind the lower bound instead.
